name: ai-agents-skills
description: Skills and optional hooks for Claude Code: Kanban boards, Git safety, review and verification, security, deployment, monitoring, research, Telegram notifications and reviewed skill import. Skills are named <area>-<object>-<goal>; the registry selects automatically invocable skills; other skills require manual invocation. Depends on the superpowers plugin. Scheduled runs use a restricted Claude-specific prototype; automatic skill replacement and direct external imports are disabled.
